ingest_order: PDF text layer: ingest sheets, figure atlas, Appendix A

catalog.source: Magic UI or Aceternity by slug

adrs.decision: Product UIs are Next.js 15 App Router.
Color is CSS variables in HSL channels. Tenant branding writes --primary and --sidebar.
The shadcn new-york catalog lives in tenant-admin. Dashboard imports the Payload-config alias.
@akademate/ui ships tokens and Pill. Primitives migrate into that package.
Tenant public is its own html document, separate from the dashboard shell.
Campus product routes live under tenant-admin. apps/campus is a scaffold.
Light and dark are a class on html.
Compose from catalog order: repo, official shadcn, motion by slug.
Tailwind v4 with theme.colors and @tailwindcss/postcss. SURF-WEB completes that cutover.
Motion on product chrome is CSS, Radix, and tw-animate. Marketing motion uses the Motion library by slug.
